label: Contracts: Restructure and Extension now check the real deadline, not just contract shape — a held veteran past the September contract deadline (e.g. a final-year player traded in mid-season) no longer shows as eligible for either. IR: the eligibility alert on Front Office only counts a real IR-type NFL designation (IR / suspended / holdout / COVID) — a plain game-day "Out" or "Doubtful" no longer inflates the count.
